killer_instinct_jago_epee.visualFinding: The eight markers lie on the forward palm/fingers, including the actual calm recovery fist. Prepare/anticipate show a small attached hand orb as explicitly requested; the body reaches forward on release2 and recovers calmly on3. This review does not call the attached preparation orb a premature travelling projectile.

magicka_yellow_wizard_froid.visualFinding: All markers select the attached cyan gem inside the held wooden staff head. The larger local frost silhouette on anticipation1 is a cosmetic charge explicitly permitted by the archived request, with no detached travelling bolt. Release2 has the forward staff/body extension; recovery3 retains the small gem.

metal_slug_marco_rossi.visualFinding: Eight markers land on the physical upper-barrel mouth, including raised preparation and lowered recovery. Painted orange muzzle flash occurs only at release2 in both sequences; no point uses the flame tip.

metal_slug_tarma_roving.visualFinding: Eight markers stay on the HMG physical muzzle. Orange flash is confined to release2 of each sequence, with preparation0/1 and recovery3 calm.

metal_slug_eri_kasamoto.visualFinding: Eight markers match the real pistol mouth. Super1 correctly follows the upward pistol near the torso instead of inventing a forward endpoint. Super2 and fatality2 alone show a painted local muzzle flash; markers remain on metal, before the bright detached stylized flash.

magicka_blue_wizard_foudre.visualFinding: Eight markers select the blue gem in the physical wooden staff head. Small attached charging arcs and residual glow exist in prepare/anticipate/recovery; the source request explicitly permits local charging. Fatality2 shows the strongest forward local discharge and both sequences have a forward casting body pose at2. No independent free travelling bolt is painted into preparation. This review does not claim all decorative light is exclusive to release2.

magicka_red_wizard_feu.visualFinding: Eight markers sit on the solid lower wooden cradle of the open staff crook, including the low recovered head. No marker is in the transparent hollow or floating fire. The small attached flame appears only at release2 of the two phases.

borderlands_2_salvador_gunzerking.visualFinding: Eight markers match the selected front-facing pistol barrel, including the metal-to-flash junction of fatality2. Two pistols are visible in several poses; this schema deliberately binds one authoritative projectile to the selected front muzzle. Super2 has no painted orange flash, so this review makes no assertion that the runtime shot requires an embedded flash. No early gun flash observed.

turok_tal_set_turok.visualFinding: Eight markers lie on the physical bow riser/arrow rest immediately above the bow hand. Preparation0/1 shows the loaded shaft and draw, release2 has the released arrow absent and a released string, recovery3 retains the real rest. Neither limb tip nor projected arrowhead is used.

turok_joshua_fireseed_turok.visualFinding: Eight markers select the actual compound-bow riser/arrow rest. The red arrow is held/loaded in0/1 and absent on release2/recovery3; no marker follows a disappearing arrowhead or transparent gap.

method: Independently read and SHA-check the current public native sheets, selected marker grids, measurement snapshot and live anchor/native registries.
Extract all80 real256x256 public cells and compare their decoded RGBA byte-for-byte with the exact archived crops used for measurement.

Rebuild each64x64 emitter zoom from the real public rectangle, nearest-neighbour enlarge4x and flatten using the documented QA background. Compare every displayed pixel outside the19x19 marker exclusion box with the listed final marker grid.
Read each actual emitter RGBA at the live anchor and independently label8-connected alpha>=24 components, requiring the anchor to belong to the largest native body/equipment component.
Actually inspect all10 selected marked grids plus all10 whole-body contacts for semantic emitter placement, held equipment, release/recovery and any premature travelling projectile or gun flash.

phaseFinding.runtimeReleaseOnlyAt2: Reported by the production author; outside this read-only sprite review and not independently claimed as browser-tested here.
phaseFinding.limitations: This is an independent physical-anchor/native-choreography review of generated adaptations. It does not certify official source-game frame fidelity, every ability slot, live gameplay timing, collisions, browser rendering or the whole40-hero batch.
